meta.title: Web Design & SEO Case Studies Kerala | Teknoppy
meta.description: Real client results from Teknoppy's web design, ecommerce, and SEO projects across Kerala, UAE, and Qatar, with verified numbers and timeframes for each.

body.html: Teknoppy has worked on website design, ecommerce, and SEO projects for clients across Kerala and the GCC. The summaries below cover real projects with real numbers, not estimates or rounded-up claims. Each one names the industry, the starting problem, and the measurable result within a stated timeframe. For a visual look at the work itself, see our Portfolio.

items.title: Ecommerce Store, Kochi
items.text: A Kochi-based retailer needed an online store that could actually be found in search, not just built and left to sit. The site launched with product pages structured for search from day one. Result: [X]% increase in organic traffic within [X] months, [X] keywords ranking in the top 10, and [X] enquiries per month through the site.

items.title: Local SEO Campaign, Kerala
items.text: A Kerala-based service business was invisible in local search results despite years of trading in the same location. Work covered a technical audit, Google Business Profile cleanup, and local content. Result: ranking moved from page [X] to position [X] for its main keyword within [X] months, with a [X]% increase in Google Business Profile calls.

items.title: Website Redesign, Qatar
items.text: A Qatar-based business was running on an outdated site with a high bounce rate and no clear path to enquiry. The redesign focused on load speed, mobile layout, and a shorter path to contact. Result: page load time dropped from [X] seconds to [X] seconds, and enquiry form submissions rose [X]% within [X] months.

items.title: Custom Booking System, UAE
items.text: A UAE-based business was managing bookings manually through phone calls and email, with no record of what was actually booked. Teknoppy built a custom booking system tied into their existing site and calendar. Result: [X]% of bookings now happen online, cutting manual admin time by roughly [X] hours a week.

items.q: Are these results typical for every project?
items.a: Results vary by industry, starting point, and competition. These summaries show real outcomes from specific projects, not a guaranteed baseline for every business.

items.q: Can I see the full details behind a result?
items.a: Reach out through Contact and we can walk through the specifics relevant to your industry and goals.

items.q: Does Teknoppy work on projects outside Kerala?
items.a: Yes. Alongside Kerala clients, the case studies above include work delivered for businesses in Qatar and the UAE.
